ONLINE SAFETY ACT 2025

ONLINE SAFETY (FEES) REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 81(2)(g) of the Online Safety Act 2025

[Act 866], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Online Safety (Fees)

Regulations 2025.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2026.

Fees

2. The fees payable to the Commission in respect of the matters specified in

column (2) of the Schedule shall be as specified in column (3) of the Schedule.
